mathematical_meanings: Left image: y gives an unknown angle measure (the y° label at the upper vertex of the right triangle). Right image: y is the dependent output variable in the formula defining the graph (the left-hand side of y = −(x + 5)(x − 5)).
Rationales: On the left, y represents an unknown angle measure (the y° label at the upper vertex of the right triangle). On the right, y is the dependent output variable in the formula defining the graph (the left-hand side of y = −(x + 5)(x − 5)).
